# czc-v2026.10.29.3 (0.2.19.4)

Account management now shows subscription expiry for OpenAI OAuth accounts
whose saved ID token contains the date but whose separate display field is
missing. OpenAI Pro tiers also show an estimated grace deadline 14 days after
subscription expiry; Plus shows 30 days.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.29.2

- OAuth login, token refresh, Codex session import and account data import
  extract `chatgpt_subscription_active_until`. Invalid or non-string optional
  values are ignored without disabling identity or token-expiry validation.
- Existing accounts and credential shadows fill a missing display date from
  the saved ID token immediately. No reimport, token rotation or database
  backfill is required. Existing dates take precedence; conflicting account
  identities or plans do not supply the fallback.
- Live subscription lookups continue to update the date. Failed or throttled
  lookups cannot replace an existing date with an older token snapshot of the
  same account and plan. Tokens remain redacted in admin API responses.
- The platform/type badge adds a separate grace deadline for OpenAI Pro
  (`pro`, `chatgptpro`, `prolite`, `promax`: 14 days) and Plus (30 days).
  It indicates when the grace period is active or has ended, updating at the
  boundaries while the page stays open. Hover text includes the local time.
- Grace periods follow the operator-requested site rule and use fixed 24-hour
  days. They are display estimates, not confirmation of upstream entitlement.
  Free, team/business, unknown plans and other providers do not receive this
  calculation. Account scheduling and administrator-set account expiry are
  unchanged.

## VERSION

`0.2.19.4`

## Upgrade and compatibility

- No database migration or configuration change. Existing credentials are
  not rewritten on page reads; future imports and refreshes persist the date.
- Build the frontend and embedded server from this tag, replace the binary
  and restart `sub2api.service`. Reload account management to receive the new
  interface and missing-date fallback.
- Saved token metadata can be stale. The displayed grace deadline inherits
  the saved subscription date and does not guarantee upstream availability.
- Existing API fields are preserved. Only missing subscription dates are
  added to the already-redacted account response.

## Verification

Passed:

- Focused Go regression tests for OAuth exchange/refresh, throttled refresh,
  live lookup precedence, malformed claims, import expiry validation,
  identity/plan mismatches, DTO redaction and credential-shadow display.
- `go test -count=1 ./...` on retry; the initial failure is recorded below.
- `go test -json -count=1 -tags unit ./...` on retry: all test-bearing
  packages passed (109 packages including packages without tests).
- `go vet ./...` and `go vet -tags unit ./internal/...`.
- Full frontend `vitest run`.
- Five focused component/i18n files: 78 tests in UTC. Grace-period tests:
  52 tests in America/New_York, including DST, leap dates, exact boundaries,
  renewal, timer cleanup and invalid dates.
- Frontend `vue-tsc --noEmit`, `vue-tsc -b`, `vite build`, changed-file ESLint,
  `gofmt`, `git diff --check`, and focused backend/frontend checks on `dev-czc`.

Failures, retries and skipped checks:

- Initial default Go suite: unrelated `TestH2PoolEndToEndTLS` failed with
  `stream closed before response headers`. The unchanged codexwire package
  passed 10 consecutive repetitions and the full default suite then passed.
- Initial full `-tags unit` run failed in `internal/service`; its retained
  output was truncated before the assertion. The complete retry captured
  per-test failures separately and passed, including `internal/service`.
- The first new frontend test run failed due to the test runner's vue-i18n
  module alias; the test import was corrected and all final runs passed.
  A 60-second typecheck timed out under concurrent build load; an independent
  typecheck and the production build subsequently passed. One focused Go
  rerun also reached its 60-second shell limit; tracked integration tests passed.
- Browser desktop/mobile visual checks could not run: Chromium is absent,
  and the Playwright browser download returned HTTP 403 (location denied).
  Component tests and production resource compilation were used instead.
- Separate `-tags integration` and e2e suites were not run; there are no
  repository/schema changes. A live upstream subscription renewal was not
  triggered. golangci-lint was not run; Go vet and targeted ESLint were run.
- Vite reported existing large-chunk/dynamic-import and outdated Browserslist
  notices; no dependency updates are included in this release.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.29.2`, or restore the pre-install binary saved as
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.29.3-<UTC timestamp>` and restart
`sub2api.service`. Verify that the homepage returns HTTP 200 and that the
installed version and `current_release_url` match the restored release.
No database rollback is needed.
